objects.taxonomy_description: Large shepherd dog with a medium-length double coat in black-and-tan, sable, or solid black. Coat is dense, straight, and close-lying with a thick undercoat. Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a distinctive sloping topline. Head is noble and clean-cut with a broad skull and long, strong muzzle. Ears are large, erect, pointed, and set high. Tail is bushy, reaches to the hock, and carried low with a slight curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its erect ears, sloping back, and noble, wolf-like appearance.

objects.taxonomy_description: Equine mammal measuring 140-170 cm at withers with athletic build. Coat uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coloration with no black points. Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen). Head elongated with large expressive eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched and muscular. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs long and slender with single hoof per foot. Tail long with flowing hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Color variant of horse distinguished by reddish-brown coat.

objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns. Tip of each rib has a small protective cap. Opening mechanism is manual (push-up) or automatic (button-activated). Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
